prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt a watercolor catalog interface to dark appearance. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS/macOS. Global filter inverts every pixel, including artwork and artist portraits. Fixed black text disappears on dark cards, selection changes only luminance slightly and temporary alerts remain blinding white.

criteria.task_completion: Patch semantic surfaces/text, preserve content fidelity for images, define selection and elevated surfaces, and list light/dark/Increase Contrast checks without claiming rendered contrast measurements.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the dark-mode guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch semantic surfaces/text, preserve content fidelity for images, define selection and elevated surfaces, and list light/dark/Increase Contrast checks without claiming rendered contrast measurements.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch semantic surfaces/text, preserve content fidelity for images, define selection and elevated surfaces, and list light/dark/Increase Contrast checks without claiming rendered contrast measurements.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
